title.rendered: Arrow Formal Shirt 100% Cotton Light Blue for Men

content.rendered:
Arrow Formal Shirt 100% Cotton for Men brings together timeless style, unmatched comfort, and a premium finish. Crafted from 100% pure cotton, this shirt ensures maximum breathability and a soft feel, making it a must-have addition to your formal wardrobe. The soothing shade adds a touch of sophistication, making it ideal for office meetings, business presentations, or any formal occasion. Premium Quality & Perfect Fit Designed by Arrow — a trusted name in men’s formal wear — this cotton formal shirt stands out for its refined craftsmanship. The shirt features a classic collar, full sleeves, and a button-down placket, offering a clean and structured look. Its tailored fit complements all body types, making you appear sharp and confident throughout the day.
Why Choose Arrow Formal Shirt for Men?

  • Made from 100% pure cotton fabric for lasting comfort.
  • Elegant perfect for professional and formal wear.
  • Soft, breathable, and skin-friendly texture for all-day ease.
  • Tailored fit for a polished, smart appearance.
  • Crafted by Arrow – one of India’s leading formal wear brands.

Style & Versatility

This men’s  formal shirt pairs effortlessly with black, navy, or grey trousers for a classic corporate look. For semi-formal events, style it with chinos and leather shoes. Whether you’re attending a meeting, interview, or evening dinner, this Arrow cotton shirt guarantees a sophisticated presence.
